title: Despair and a Promise of Revenge
overview: Elizabeth is Prince Friede's devoted fiancée and works tirelessly for the kingdom and its people.

title: Starting Business In Asylum
overview: Elizabeth, now Ellie, starts a cosmetics business in a neighboring town under Viscount Lucas's domain.

title: Met on the Road
overview: Ellie expands her business in the imperial capital and meets someone unusual along the way.

title: New Friends and Social Parties
overview: After arriving in the capital, Ellie begins to build her circle of potential clients.

title: Adventurers Assemble
overview: An unexpected conflict jeopardizes Ellie's plan, forcing her to take action.

title: Taking Back the Fortress
overview: Ellie and her men join Lebrick's army to retake Broccen Fortress.

title: Revenge in the Dead of Night
overview: The empire's troops are preparing to lay siege to the capital of Sarjas with the help of a new ally.

title: The Tragedy of the House of Count Arty
overview: Robert returns home alive with those he most wants to protect.

title: The Empire's Merchants' Guild Council
overview: Ellie auditions for membership in the empire's Merchants' Guild Council.
